attributes.name: Blood Moon Pirate
attributes.powers:
Before you act, if the top card of the blessings discard pile is a blessing that has the Basic trait, the difficulty of the check to defeat the Blood Moon Pirate is increased by 3.

If the check to defeat has the Swashbuckling trait, after you act, discard the top card of the blessings deck.

corrections.corrected_text: Change “Blessing of the Gods” to “a blessing that has the Basic trait” on the following cards: monster Blood Moon Pirate (B), loot item Svingli’s Eye (2), monster Werecrocodile (3), loot blessing Pirate’s Favor (3), ship Blood Moon (4—twice on the front, once on the back), villain Fargo Vitterande (4), ally Avimar Sorrinash (4), villain Captain Horrus Riptooth (6), henchman Wereshark Pirate (6), blessing Blessing of Zogmugot (P).
corrections.issue: A bunch of cards refer to Blessing of the Gods, but what if I’m using them with sets without that card?
